Package org.cyclops.colossalchests2.api

Record Class ChestMaterial

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.api.ChestMaterial
Record Components:
id - The material id, matching its data file.
public record ChestMaterial(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation id) extends Record
A chest material, identified by its id. Everything tunable about it, including its order, comes from its data file data/[namespace]/colossalchests2/material/[name].json, see MaterialProperties. A material exists when a core block is registered for it, see IColossalChestsApi.createCore(net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour.Properties, org.cyclops.colossalchests2.api.ChestMaterial).
